audit.why: Tricky (51.61% WR, 7768 games): Sylas wins early, skill 3-5, Sylas at 6, Yone from first item on. Matches data.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart says Yone on rows 0,1,4 while content win[] and packet both say Sylas; full phases[4].why even described a Sylas advantage under a Yone side.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; Yone pays health on Q resets early and a baited Q3 loses him the level-6 all-in. Sides/ratings/whys fixed atomically; win[] already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer labels Soul Unbound as 'W-wraith form' and credits wraith form with shield/effective HP. Soul Unbound is Yone's E; the shield is Spirit Cleave (W, 14s base cooldown).
audit.why: Kit file: W = Spirit Cleave (cone + shield), E = Soul Unbound (spirit form, snaps back and repeats damage), R = Fate Sealed. Q3 knockup at 2 stacks is the trade-opener.
audit.corrected: Slot labels and shield attribution fixed; real cooldowns inserted in breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1 falling to 10 — his burst window. Survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave's shield runs a 14s base timer — trade just after it pops. - Your E Abscond is for when it goes wrong; the R for when it goes right.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Q3's gust wind-up is the tell — Abscond back on the windup, then chain in the second it whiffs; he has no second knockup.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: First-mythic Yone with Soul Unbound covers your exact all-in window — trade short there or wait for jungle help.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Yone wins by landing the Q3 knockup into a Soul Unbound all-in, eating your burst with Spirit Cleave shields.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Yone has no sustain and pays health on every Q reset — Chain Lash poke wins level 1 for free.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: Rank-2 Q double-hits the wave and chunks him whenever he steps up to CS — still yours.

edits.before: Hijack online — your R is whatever his best button is. The lane's power budget just became a shared account.
edits.after: Bait the Q3 whiff and your E-Q-R burst kills him before wraith form buffers it — 6 swings to you.

edits.before: This is a danger window: Yone hits 6 and his ultimate Fate Sealed lets him blink through your whole team, and his Q3 into Soul Unbound (W-wraith form) all-in out-damages a naked Sylas R. Respect his level-6 timer and don't shove blindly into a warded river.
edits.after: This is a danger window: Yone hits 6 and his ultimate Fate Sealed lets him blink through your whole team, and his Q3 into Soul Unbound (E, wraith form) all-in out-damages a naked Sylas R. Respect his level-6 timer and don't shove blindly into a warded river.

edits.before: Yone tips ahead here once he completes a first mythic and starts weaving Soul Unbound into every trade; his effective HP from wraith form plus Q-reset burst covers the exact all-in window your E-Q-Kingslayer combo needs. Play for waves and sidelane pressure rather than raw 1v1s until you match items.
edits.after: Yone tips ahead here once he completes a first mythic and starts weaving Soul Unbound into every trade; his Spirit Cleave shielding plus Q-reset burst covers the exact all-in window your E-Q-Kingslayer combo needs. Play for waves and sidelane pressure rather than raw 1v1s until you match items.

edits.before: Weave W wraith form into extended trades so your burst bounces off his shield-HP
edits.after: Weave Spirit Cleave (W) shields into trades so your burst bounces off shield-HP
